full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 10
Federal
Nepal
Parliament,
Daily Agenda
Tuesday, Jestha 12, 2083
11:00 AM
Management Work
1. The Honorable Minister for Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation, Khadak Raj Poudel, will present the proposal to "Consider the Tourism Bill, 2082".
2. On behalf of the Right Honorable Prime Minister, Home Minister, and Minister for Science, Technology, and Innovation, the Honorable Minister for Law, Justice, and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam, will present the following proposals:-
(a) "Send the National Forensic Science Laboratory (Establishment and Operation) Bill, 2082 to the relevant committee for clause-by-clause discussion."
(b) "Conduct clause-by-clause discussion in the House on the Representative Members of the House of Representatives (First Amendment) Bill, 2083."
(c) "Pass the Representative Members of the House of Representatives (First Amendment) Bill, 2083."
(d) "Conduct clause-by-clause discussion in the House on the Voter List (First Amendment) Bill, 2083."
(e) "Pass the Voter List (First Amendment) Bill, 2083."
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
